description: Check whether e-invoicing applies to a business and its deadline: Saudi ZATCA Phase 1 and Phase 2 waves, UAE e-invoicing phases (Ministerial Decisions 243 and 244 of 2025), Pakistan FBR electronic invoicing (S.R.O. 1852(I)/2025). Every line cites its legal reference and official source; unconfirmed facts are marked "Being verified" and not used.

business_type.description: Pakistan: public = public listed company, company = other company, individual = individual or association of persons.

conducts_business_in_uae.description: UAE: does the person conduct business in the UAE?

country.description: sa = Saudi Arabia (ZATCA), ae = United Arab Emirates (MoF/FTA), pk = Pakistan (FBR).

customers.description: Who you invoice: b2b = businesses, b2g = government, b2c = consumers.

entity_type.description: UAE: business, or gov = government entity.

imports_goods.description: Pakistan: does the business import goods?

resident.description: Saudi Arabia: is the business resident in Saudi Arabia?

revenue.description: UAE: gross revenue in the most recent accounting period (AED).

revenue_by_year.description: Saudi Arabia: revenue subject to VAT (SAR) for each year the ZATCA waves use: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. Leave a year out if not trading.

sales_tax_registered.description: Pakistan: registered for sales tax with the FBR?

turnover.description: Pakistan: turnover declared in sales tax returns for the last twelve months (PKR).

vat_registered.description: Saudi Arabia or UAE: is the business registered for VAT there?

name: einvoicing_check
title: E-invoicing scope and deadline (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Pakistan)
